rows.text: Riya's home internet since January 2026 is TekSavvy Fibre 1 Gbps at $70/month ($79.10 with HST), pre-authorized debit on the 15th, service address Leslieville, Toronto; customer-owned modem. Bell Fibe was cancelled effective 2026-01-02 and is no longer used.
